description: Read and, after exact approval, update a configured Google Sheets GTD system with stable action ids and archive-before-clear lifecycle rules.

onboarding.question: Which Google Sheet and tabs should act as the GTD system?
setup_questions: What is the native Google Sheet URL or spreadsheet id?
Which close-day scopes belong in the sheet, and what Area value maps to each?
Which tabs contain Next Actions, Waiting Fors, Inbox, Action Archive, and per-scope Projects?
Does the sheet expose stable Close Action ID and source metadata columns?
May approved writes upsert actions and archive completed rows before clearing them?
connector_probes: Read spreadsheet metadata and required header rows without changing the sheet.
required_artifacts: GTD Sheet with Next Actions, Waiting Fors, Inbox, Action Archive, Projects, and Lists.
